issue_context.title: Openerz integration sensor returning string instead of timestamp
issue_context.body:
### The problem

The Openerz integration sensor returns the next pickup date for trash in Zurich. However, the current integration returns a string in the format "%Y-%m-%d" and not a home assistant style timestamp.

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2022.4.0

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant OS

### Integration causing the issue

Openerz

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/openerz/

### Diagnostics information

_No response_

### Example YAML snippet

```yaml
sensor:
  - platform: openerz
    name: Pappe
    zip: 8002
    waste_type: cardboard
  - platform: openerz
    name: Papier
    zip: 8002
    waste_type: paper
```


### Anything in the logs that might be useful for us?

_No response_

### Additional information

_No response_
